prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
If you mean a **spray tan**, **Sun Studio Tan** in the Short North looks like a strong pick: it reports 384 verified reviews, with customers praising natural-looking results and friendly service. It’s at **612 N. High St.**; [see its website](https://www.sunstudiotan.com/).

For **UV tanning beds**, Palm Beach Tan has several Columbus locations. Its Georgesville location shows a particularly high **4.86/5 from 147 reviews** on the results I found.

“Best” depends on whether you want a spray tan or UV tanning—and ratings can change—so check recent reviews and pricing before booking.
